attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: sum_(i<=t) p_t(z_ti) v_i; p_t(z) = h_t(z); h_t(z) = A_t(z)^2 + B_t(z)^2, deg A = 4, deg B = 3; square factors F_j(x_t) = f_j (1 + g_j(x_t))/2, g_j = b_j + a_j tanh(W_j^T x_t); fixed f factorizes T_8, b initially 1, a initially 0; z = softplus(s), s = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k); x_t is the pre-attention RMSNorm activation; factors and expanded coefficients computed in FP32; every weight is multiplied by the prefactor f(s_ti) of the raw score s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k), f(s_ti) = sigmoid(s_ti) = 1 / (1 + exp(-s_ti)), evaluated with exp(-|s_ti|); then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain; head RMSNorm evaluated on each token and head's output divided by its largest magnitude, a constant to differentiation, with its epsilon divided by that magnitude's square (an output too small for that keeps its plain evaluation): the same function, with an FP32 gradient that is exact to rounding wherever FP32 holds the gradient itself (its elements are of size cotangent / output RMS, and FP32's normal range ends at 1.2e-38)
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <RoPE(g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps)), RoPE(g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps))> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero

coefficients.effective_coefficient_formula: p_t(z) = sum_r c_r(x_t) z^r; c_r already include factorial scaling
coefficients.generator_axis: square factor index, not expanded polynomial order

score_transform.decreasing_formula: dp/dz = sum_(r=1..m) r c_r(x_t) z_ti^(r-1) < 0, with each query's own coefficients: the polynomial factor of W = f(s) p(z) alone, without the prefactor f
score_transform.formula: W(t,i) = f(s_ti) p(z_ti), p(z_ti) = sum_r c_r(x_t) z_ti^r, z_ti = softplus(s_ti) = log(1 + exp(s_ti)), evaluated as max(s_ti, 0) + log1p(exp(-|s_ti|)), f(s_ti) = sigmoid(s_ti) = 1 / (1 + exp(-s_ti)), evaluated with exp(-|s_ti|)
score_transform.note: measured by the blocked reference of the same kernel, forward only, over causal pairs

polynomial_input_histogram.bins: underflow (z < -16), [e, e + 1) for each edge e < 16, overflow (z >= 16)

raw_score_histogram.bins: underflow (s < -16), [e, e + 1) for each edge e < 16, overflow (s >= 16)
